previous_statement: Terminological bridge fixed by the target shard: in the Cairns/Veblen-Whitehead terminology used by GT-cairns-1935-theorem-p549, a manifold of class one is what the contract calls a C^1 manifold, and an allowable coordinate system is a C^1 coordinate chart. Thus the chart domains in node 1.1.1 are domains of allowable coordinate systems.
new_statement: Terminological bridge fixed by the target shard: the given C^1 manifold is regarded as a Cairns/Veblen-Whitehead manifold of class one, and its class-one atlas consists of allowable coordinate systems. Consequently, when node 1.1.1 is applied to this atlas, its chart domains are precisely domains of allowable coordinate systems.
